predecessors.name: Gupta Empire
predecessors.text: Kalinga, "mainly confined between the southern part of Odisha and the river Godavari": the Srikakulam country (grants at Ragolu and Andhavaram), Pishtapura (Pithapuram) and Ganjam

successors.name: Pitrbhakta Dynasty
successors.text: Kalinga, "mainly confined between the southern part of Odisha and the river Godavari": the Srikakulam country (grants at Ragolu and Andhavaram), Pishtapura (Pithapuram) and Ganjam

ledger.x: c. 350: the Mathara dynasty rises in Kalinga. The page: the dynasty "ruled Kalinga from the mid-4th century to the end of the 5th century"; infobox "Established: c. 4th century CE"; Shaktivarman is the earliest known ruler, with the title Kalingadhipati and a copper-plate in his 13th regnal year from Pishtapura. The…

c. 499: the Mathara dynasty ends. "Anantashaktivarman appears to have been overthrown by the Pitrbhakta king Umavarman" (undated); the dynasty ruled "to the end of the 5th century" and "Disestablished: c. 5th century CE" in the infobox. The Matharas "fought the Vasisthas and the Pitrbhaktas for control of Kalinga"…

wars.name: Mathara wars with the Vasishthas and Pitrbhaktas
wars.outcome: The Matharas fought the Vasishthas and the Pitrbhaktas for control of Kalinga; Umavarman of the Pitrbhaktas overthrew Anantashaktivarman and Pishtapura passed to the Vasishthas.

certainty.note: No border is given; the extent is the Kalinga coast between southern Odisha and the Godavari, with the Krishna claim called an exaggeration.
